name: HarnessRouter
description: Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes and 28 other agent harnesses behind one OpenAI Responses-compatible API, with sessions, files, streaming and shared memory; self-host or cloud.

skills.name: Run Harness Tasks
skills.description: Runs a task on a chosen harness through the Responses-compatible API, selecting it with metadata.harness_id.

skills.name: Idempotent Retries
skills.description: Returns the first result when a request is retried with the same Idempotency-Key, without running the task twice.

skills.name: Task Files
skills.description: Attaches files to a task so they land in the agent's working directory before every turn that carries them.

skills.name: Harness Memory
skills.description: Keeps long-term memory for each agent that loads at session start and can be shared by agents on different harnesses.
